sharedStem: 1. Find the cardinal number of the following sets.

items.sourceText: (i) M = {p, q, r, s, t, u}
stepsEn: The cardinal number of a set is the number of distinct elements it contains.
M contains p, q, r, s, t and u, all distinct.
W is the set of whole numbers, so n = 0, 1, 2, ... .
Therefore n = 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4; the resulting x values are 2, 5, 8, 11 and 14.
